# sorobeacon_monitor (Resource)

Manages a SoroBeacon monitor.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contract_ids` (List of String) Soroban contract addresses to watch.
- `name` (String) Monitor display name.

### Optional

- `channel_ids` (List of Number) Notification channel IDs to alert.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is active.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
